rules.text: voice is a MELODY imposed on an existing stem: no consonant is added or removed, so a voice row is a vocalised skeleton, not a new template family
each row is written as a letter shape over SUPPLIED radicals; a row is a survivor only on an exact letter match, and the radicals are never derived here

where the active and passive melodies of a cell share one consonant skeleton the pack declares BOTH rows, so the cell collides and the unit abstains ambiguous_template — that abstention IS the correct verdict for unvocalised text, not a defect

where the melody changes a LETTER — the third form's long low vowel becoming a long back vowel in the perfect passive, and the medial-weak cells in both tenses — the rows are distinct and the voice is decidable from the letters alone

medial-weak rows are matched against the two SOUND radicals, with the weak radical and its position carried in the evidence record; the melody letter is a template literal because it is an exponent of voice, not a realization of the radical
the imperfect passive melody overwrites the lexically stored active vowel, so that vowel is NOT recoverable from a passive surface and is never reported from one
promotion of the patient to subject and the agreement that follows are syntactic consequences; this unit classifies the verb's voice and emits no case or agreement fact
final-weak, doubly weak and geminate stem classes have NO row in this pack; a surface from those classes abstains no_template rather than borrowing a sound-stem melody
